$comment: Weak-spot (body-part) damage for the builder's 'Targeting weak spot' state. The base multiplier is the creature's head/weak-point body-part multiplier from fallout.wiki's Fallout 76 combat table ('Hitting any body part modifies the incoming damage with a body part multiplier; similar to a sneak attack, the damage dealt is multiplied by this number'). Perk and innate bonuses are fractions of that multiplier and add together before multiplying (approximate stacking model; Bethesda publishes no formula). Keys under `dummies` are the engine's target-dummy ids (combat-firepower-catalog.ts).
source: https://fallout.wiki/wiki/Fallout_76_combat (hit-location multiplier table); perk texts from src/data/perk-cards.json (Patch 70); innates from unique-items-official-p70.json

scorchbeast-queen.part: Head (Scorchbeast row; the Queen is not listed separately)

gunslinger.note: Patch 62 rework: Gunslinger is weak-spot damage, not flat pistol damage

gunslinger-expert.condition: ranged weapons; the card also raises the Onslaught cap by 3
